findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess call with shell=True
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Subprocess or os command execution call that may be unsafe if using shell=True or processing untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Check for subprocess calls with shell=True which can be dangerous

message.text: Subprocess or os command execution call that may be unsafe if using shell=True or processing untrusted input.

 * @description Regular expressions with exponential worst-case behavior can cause denial of service
 * @kind problem

 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Regular expression operation that may be vulnerable to ReDoS if pattern has catastrophic backtracking."
findings.hypothesis: Check for regular expression operations that could be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks
